L58@P3: 1 Preface 前言
L59@P3: This specification describes the type, dimension, performance, technical characteristics, warnings and
L60@P3: cautions of the cylindrical lithium-ion rechargeable cell. The specification only applies to N21700CH-58E cell
L61@P3: supplied by Zhengzhou BAK Battery Co., Ltd. 本标准描述了圆柱型锂离子电芯的外型、尺寸、特性、技术要求及注意事项。本标准适用于郑州比克
L62@P3: 电池有限公司生产的圆柱型 N21700CH-58E 锂离子电芯。
L63@P3: 2 Definition 定义
L64@P3: 2.1 Standard charge method 标准充电方式
L65@P3: At 25 ± 2 ℃, the cell is charged to 4.20 V at constant current of 0.5C (2800 mA), then charged at constant
L66@P3: voltage of 4.20 V until the current is ≤ 0.01C (56 mA) followed by resting for 5 min. 在 25 ± 2 ℃下，电芯以0.5C (2800 mA)恒流充电至4.20 V后，以4.20 V恒压充电至电流小于等于 0.01C
L67@P3: (56 mA)，静置 5 min。
L68@P3: 2.2 Standard discharge method 标准放电方式
L69@P3: Under 25 ± 2 ℃, the cell is discharged to 2.50 V at a constant current of 0.2C (1120 mA). 指在 25 ± 2 ℃环境下，电芯以 0.2C（1120 mA）恒流放电至 2.50 V。
L70@P3: 2.3 Rated capacity 额定容量
L71@P3: Rated capacity refers to the minimum capacity of the cell, using mAh as unit. Specifically, it refers to the
L72@P3: minimum value of the capacity, which is obtained by discharging a cell via standard discharge method after
L73@P3: standard charge. 额定容量指的是电芯的最小容量，单位为毫安时（mAh）。具体地说，是指电芯按标准充电方式充电
L74@P3: 后，按标准放电方式放电得到的容量最小值。
L75@P3: 2.4 Typical capacity 典型容量
L76@P3: Typical capacity is the typical value of the cell’s capacity, which is obtained by discharging a cell via
L77@P3: standard discharge method after standard charge, using mAh as unit. 典型容量指的是电芯容量的典型值，指电芯按标准充电方式充电后，按标准放电方式放电得到的容量
L78@P3: 典型值，单位为毫安时（mAh）。
L79@P3: 2.5 Nominal voltage 标称电压
L80@P3: Nominal voltage of the cell, refers to the platform value of the discharge voltage via standard discharge
L81@P3-4: method after standard charge. The unit is volt (V). 电芯标称电压，指的是按标准充电方式充电后，按标准放电方式放电电压的平台值，单位为伏特（V）。Document No P/PR03/PB-D-N21700CH-58E-ZZ-SP Version A/00 Page
L82@P4: This spec manual is the enterprise standard of ZhengZhou BAK Battery Co., Ltd. Without authorization, any pirate or circulation is prohibited. 本规格书为郑州比克电池有限公司企业标准，未经授权，禁止翻印、传播。
L83@P4: 2 /19
L84@P4: 2.6 Rated energy 额定能量
L85@P4: Rated energy of the cell is calculated by multiplying the nominal voltage by the rated capacity. The unit is
L86@P4: watt hour (Wh). 电芯额定能量通过标称电压乘以额定容量计算得出，单位为瓦时（Wh）。
L87@P4: 2.7 Typical energy 典型能量
L88@P4: Typical energy of the cell is calculated by multiplying the nominal voltage by the typical capacity. The unit is
L89@P4: watt hour (Wh). 电芯典型能量通过标称电压乘以典型容量计算得出，单位为瓦时（Wh）。
L90@P4: 2.8 Limited charging voltage 充电限制电压
L91@P4: Limited charging voltage of the cell, refers to the rated maximum charging voltage of the cell, expressed in
L92@P4: Ucl. 电芯充电限制电压，指的是电芯的额定最大充电电压，以 Ucl表示。
L93@P4: 2.9 End of discharge voltage 放电终止电压
L94@P4: End of discharge voltage of the cell, refers to the voltage at the end of the standard discharge of the cell, expressed in Ude. 电芯放电终止电压，指的是电芯标准放电结束时的电压，以 Ude表示。
L95@P4: 2.10 Upper limited charging voltage 充电上限电压
L96@P4: Upper limited charging voltage of the cell, refers to the highest safe charging voltage that the cell can
L97@P4: withstand, expressed in Uup. 电芯的充电上限电压，指的是电芯能承受的最高安全充电电压，以 Uup表示。
L98@P4: 2.11 Discharge cut-off voltage 放电截止电压
L99@P4: Discharge cut-off voltage of the cell, refers to the minimum safe discharge loaded voltage that the cell can
L100@P4: withstand, expressed in Udo. 电芯的放电截止电压，指的是电芯能承受的安全放电最低负载电压，以 Udo表示。
L101@P4: 2.12 Allowable maximum surface temperature 可允许的最高表面温度
L102@P4: Allowable maximum surface temperature of the cell, refers to the allowable maximum surface temperature of
L103@P4: the cell under normal working conditions, expressed in Tmax. 电芯可允许最高表面温度，指的是电芯在正常的工作条件下电芯表面可允许的最高温度，以 Tmax表示。
